Riot's record has the deaths in rounds 2, 5 and 6, 31, 33 and 3 seconds in, rounds 1 to 4 won on defence, round 5 lost and round 6 won on attack. 8.4.0 locked standard on the round 4 end countdown, and the final 5 to 1 was never read. Two words no list knows were checked and kept: Aide, the model's own label for a bridge, and M4A1, its name for a rifle.
